Introducing Phi-5

Today we are releasing Phi-5, a seven billion parameter language model trained mostly on carefully filtered synthetic data. The model is designed to run on a single consumer GPU.

On the MATH benchmark Phi-5 scores 71 percent, which is comparable to models that are five times larger. On coding benchmarks it solves 58 percent of HumanEval problems.

The weights are available under the MIT license on Hugging Face, together with a technical report that describes the data pipeline and the evaluation methodology in detail.

We also publish a small set of safety evaluations. The model still makes factual mistakes and should not be used for high-stakes decisions without human review.
